1.
List of fresh cases revised.

3.

The writ petition seeks quashing of the F.I.R. dated 09.01.2024 giving rise to Case Crime No. 9 of 2024, under Sections 376, 506 IPC and Section 3(2)(v) SC/ST Act, Police Station- Bhopa, District Muzaffar Nagar.
4. On 13.02.2024, following order was passed.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned A.G.A.-I for the State.

2. This writ petition has been filed praying for the following reliefs:
"(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 9.1.2024 registered as Case Crime No. 9 of 2024,
under Sections 376, 506 IPC and 3(2)(V) SC/ST Act, Police Station- Bhopa, District- Muzaffarnagar (Annexure No. 1 to this writ petition).

(ii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents not to arrest or harass the petitioner in pursuance of impugned First Information Report."
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the impugned FIR has been lodged on false/vexatious/mischievous allegations and no offences are made out against the petitioner as alleged.
He has placed reliance on the application u/s 156(3) Cr.P.C., which was moved by the petitioner against the respondent no. 4 in the year 2023, wherein, the report was called on 1.2.2024.
In this backdrop, he submits that as a counter-blast to the said proceeding, impugned FIR has been lodged.

Certain financial transactions have also been relied upon and the same has also been brought on record as Annexure No. 2 to the writ petition.
4.
Before proceeding further, let the learned AGA-I obtain necessary instructions in the matter.

5. Put up this matter on 28.2.2024 as fresh.
6.

Till the next date of listing, respondents are restrained to arrest the petitioner pursuant to the impugned FIR dated 9.1.2024 subject to cooperation in the on-going investigation."
5.
No counter affidavit has been filed in this case despite the informant being represented by Sri Vijay Pratap Singh.
It is admitted that investigation is still going on.

6. In view of the above, this writ petition is disposed of with direction that cognizance is taken on the police report by the court below, petitioner shall not be arrested pursuant to the impugned F.I.R.
Order Date :- 16.4.2024 Pratima (Surendra Singh-I,J.) (Siddharth,J.)
